The campaign story · Six weeks in Austin

Styled for
Every Side.

A localized Aritzia campaign for the moments between campus, career, time off, and plans out. One city. Every side of your style.

The idea

One wardrobe.
More ways to live in it.

Selected pieces move through Campus, Career, Off-Duty, and Social—showing how style can keep up with a changing day.

Why Aritzia

Aritzia is a Canadian fashion house built around “Everyday Luxury.” Its apparel spans workwear, essentials, activewear, and going-out pieces. This campaign brings those sides together through an Austin lens and connects them to its existing boutique at The Domain.

Austin shows up in the light, architecture, greenery, and everyday settings.

Goal & audience

Made for every side of your day.

Build awareness and engagement, then encourage interest in visiting Aritzia at The Domain during the six-week campaign.

Proposed audience

Austin-area women ages 21–29, especially upper-level or graduate students and early-career professionals looking for polished, versatile style.

Proposed campaign targets

Goals for the six-week campaign; these are not measured results.

75,000Austin-area accounts reached
4%Engagement rate
500Campaign landing-page visits
200Boutique info, directions, or styling clicks
100Styling-event registrations
60+Event attendees

The four sides

Every side has a look.

From the first stop of the day to wherever it goes next.

Platform & channel plan

See it. Style it. Experience it.

Each channel has a role in moving the story forward.

Instagram

Reels, carousels, and Stories introduce the four sides. Austin-focused paid social supports reach.

TikTok

Short outfit transitions show one piece moving through different moments.

Aritzia digital

The Austin Edit, featured looks, email, and event details make the campaign easy to explore.

The Domain

A four-side edit and styling experience bring the idea into the boutique.
